strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a significant factor today on this abrasive surface, especially on the soft compound.
The pit lane length here at Montreal makes for a relatively quick pit stop, rewarding aggressive strategy calls.
Fuel consumption will be a concern, particularly in the early stages of the race behind the safety car.
The long straights offer overtaking opportunities, but getting the tire temperatures right after a safety car is crucial.
